sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying any transformation to Nothing still yields Nothing
sketches.resonance: No matter what you try to make of absence, it remains absence.
sketches.draft:
transform :: Maybe a -> (a -> b) -> Maybe b
transform who f = fmap f who

lost = transform Nothing (+1)

sketches.mechanism: Sending on a channel with no receiver blocks forever — a goroutine waiting indefinitely to be heard
sketches.resonance: A message spoken to no one suspends the speaker in eternal waiting.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with a single method that is never implemented — a contract no class fulfills
sketches.resonance: A promise defined so precisely that no one ever keeps it.
